# MogDop's Chromakey Mod

A lightweight and survival-friendly Fabric mod designed specifically for content creators, animators, and VFX artists who want to build high-quality green, blue, or red screens inside Minecraft.

![All Chromakey Colors 3.0.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d8d66f3ce1754847e0da03669c581ae692dd33a.png)

---

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/1_-lVnkTKOE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Key Features

*   **Flat & Uniform Rendering:** Chromakey blocks have directional shading disabled. This ensures a flat, uniform color surface under almost any lighting conditions—crucial for clean keying in video editing software.
*   **Luminous Toggle:** Right-click the block with an empty hand to turn on self-illumination. The block will render at full brightness even in complete darkness, making it highly versatile for indoor studio setups.
*   **Three Colors in One:** Easily cycle through **Green, Blue, and Red** screens depending on your post-production needs.
*   **Smart Connected Propagation:** No need to configure blocks individually. Toggling or recoloring a block automatically propagates the change to all adjacent, touching chromakey blocks. You can control massive screens with a single click!
*   **Chromakey Controller:** A dedicated tool used to cycle colors across connected screens.
*   **Creative Tab:** All blocks and items are neatly organized in a custom creative inventory tab for easy access.

---

## Crafting Recipes

Both the block and the controller are fully craftable in Survival mode, allowing you to build screens in any game mode.

### 1. Chromakey Block (Yields 8 Blocks)
Crafted by surrounding a piece of Smooth Stone and Glowstone Dust with Lime Dye.

![Chromakey Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ee44f1461f31f96e87af0eabc646e4095ea75b8.png)

### 2. Chromakey Controller
A vertical assembly of an Amethyst Shard, Redstone Dust, and an Iron Ingot inside a crafting table.

![Controller recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca51a3f459dd78cd97467df37736fd633f8cad57_0.webp)
